main.description: Add a DID to, or remove it from, a private feed's allowlist. Only the feed's owner (the author of its declaration) may call it. The list stays private to the coordinator. Authenticated with atproto service auth.

errors.name: FeedNotFound
errors.description: No declaration at that AT-URI names this coordinator.

errors.name: NotFeedOwner
errors.description: The caller did not write the feed's declaration.

errors.name: SubjectNotRegistered
errors.description: The DID is not a registered requester or agent.
